summary: Examined three screenshots of layout overflow issues caused by a recent commit that moved the full workspace path into the sidebar. Diagnosed that `[data-ui='workspace-entry'] small` had `flex: none` (designed for a short thread count), now blowing the sidebar grid wider than its rail and slicing every row mid-glyph, and identified similar overflow sources in the workspace screen header and git extension file tree. Began applying fixes starting with the sidebar: replaced the `small` rule in `apps/app/src/styles/sidebar-parts/layout.css` so it shrinks, ellipsizes, and yields to hover actions.
decisions: Sidebar fix: `[data-ui='workspace-entry'] small` should shrink and ellipsize (`min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap`) instead of `flex: none`, because it now carries the full filesystem path which has no break opportunities and previously forced the row wider than the sidebar rail.
Keep `display: none` on hover/focus-within for the `small` element, matching the existing pattern where the hint yields to row actions.

Plan to also fix `apps/app/src/styles/workspace-dashboard.css` (workspace-screen-header wrap + workspace-path span ellipsis + section-heading span ellipsis) for issue_2, and `packages/git/src/web/git.css` in the gizmo-registry repo (overlay `[data-ui='change-actions']` instead of reserving space) for issue_1 — edits not yet applied in this segment.
